annotation_method: Approximate manual full-source-image visible-extent boxes from exact decoded frames, nearest-neighbor enlarged crops and box overlays. Single reviewer, no detector-prediction assistance; independent extent review still needed.
evaluation_status: Development only: previously inspected recording and point-evaluation intervals. Same lion-recording group as existing clips/labels; not independent validation.
source_transform: Prepared 720x860 source is the first 180 original decoded frames cropped [0,140,720,1000) then reencoded. Original x=x, original y=y+140, original decoded index=index.
scope_note: Boxes concern the entire prepared image, not the old [161,326,563,517] point-evaluation ROI. Visible boxes at 78 and 81 lie outside that ROI; existing uncertain point labels remain unchanged. Border/occluded ambiguous extents remain uncertain.
